surfaces.name: Rough asphalt
surfaces.description: Coarse or imperfect paved surface with higher rolling losses.

surfaces.name: Hardpack gravel
surfaces.description: Firm unsealed surface with small loose material.

surfaces.name: Loose gravel
surfaces.description: Deeper or less consolidated aggregate where rolling losses rise.

surfaces.name: Trail
surfaces.description: Irregular off-road surface represented with an effective rolling coefficient.

notes: Reference performance assumptions for Bike Atlas simulation, not measurements of a manufacturer bicycle.
CdA includes a representative rider position and therefore is not a property of the frame alone.
Surface coefficients are educational effective values, not measured data for a specific tire.
Reference trail-bike assumptions for educational comparison only.
Effective trail rolling resistance compresses many terrain and suspension losses into one simple coefficient.
Actual MTB aerodynamic drag varies strongly with rider posture, clothing and speed.
Reference upright utility-bike assumptions, not a claim about all city bicycles.
The relatively large CdA represents an upright rider posture, not frame drag alone.
Drivetrain efficiency is a simple aggregate reference and does not model individual internal-gear hub ratios.
Reference all-road assumptions for Bike Atlas simulation, not manufacturer test data.
The gravel surface coefficients represent an effective mixed-surface model rather than one real tire.
